messages:
Maria K: Morning — quick sync: we want to push the benchmark thread next Tue. Need two formats: a 6-tweet X thread + LinkedIn long post + 1 hero image. Target publish window: Tue 10:00 AM PT. Spreadsheet w/ copy + slots: https://bit.ly/rw-bench-sched

Kevin L: I can take copy for X thread. Can someone drop the final benchmark numbers (p95 latency, cost/token delta)?

Sam P: I'll export the charts. Sending exports by EOD. Command I used:
```
python tools/export_bench.py --model=redwood-v1 --out=assets/bench_chart.png
```

Jamal R: Can we get hero image spec? Also need alt text for accessibility.

Emily S: Scheduling ops: I'll queue in Sprout Social once we have final copy + images. For X, we schedule as a thread by posting the first tweet and then replies in sequence (Sprout does this). Handle: @redwoodai. Please drop final files into the folder: https://drive.redwood.com/bench-launch

Olivia G: For inbound routing — set utm_campaign=bench_launch_2026 and utm_source=x|linkedin as appropriate. HubSpot rule: create contact + assign to SDR queue 'Bench Launch' (owner: SDR-Bench). Also we should add a lead status: 'engaged-social'.

Kevin L: Copy draft (v0) below, pls quick review:
1) Tweet 1: "New benchmark: same model, 2x throughput, 0.6x cost — how we did it. Thread👇 :rocket:"
2) Tweet 2: "Key trick: adaptive KV caching + batch selection. Reduced per-token GPU cycles by 40%..."
3) [snip for brevity]

Olivia G: Quick ask — add `?utm_campaign=bench_launch_2026&utm_medium=social&utm_source=x` to the shortlink.

Maria K: Engagement owners: Kevin covers first-hour monitoring; Jamal will handle follow-ups + quoting. Emily will escalate any high-intent replies to Olivia.

scheduler-bot: Event created — "Bench launch: social posts" Tue 10:00 AM PT — Sprout queue slot #3. (scheduled)

Maria K: Awesome. DEADLINES: final copy & images by Mon 18:00 PT. If anyone needs more time shout now. :eyes:

Kevin L: Got it, aiming EOD Mon.

Sam P: Charts uploaded: assets/bench_chart.png, assets/latency_hist.png

Jamal R: I'll draft alt text and a pinned comment template.

Emily S: Noted. I'll post check-off once scheduled. :white_check_mark:

Maria K: Thanks team — we'll reconvene if any blockers. :rocket:
